name: @tocharianou/cloudwatch-mcp

tools.name: query_logs
tools.description: Run a CloudWatch Logs Insights query against one or more log groups. Supports full Logs Insights SQL-like syntax: filter, stats, sort, limit. Ideal for: VPC Flow Log anomaly detection, application error analysis, access pattern investigation, Lambda execution tracing. IMPORTANT: Always include a LIMIT clause (e.g. "limit 20") to avoid token overflow.

logGroupNames.description: List of CloudWatch log group names to query (up to 20). Example: ["/aws/lambda/my-function", "/aws/eks/my-cluster/application"]

queryString.description: CloudWatch Logs Insights query string. Example: "fields @timestamp, @message | filter @message like /ERROR/ | sort @timestamp desc | limit 20". Always include a LIMIT clause to control result size.

startTime.description: Start time. ISO format ("2025-01-01T00:00:00Z") or relative ("1 hour ago", "3 days ago"). Defaults to "1 hour ago".

endTime.description: End time. ISO format or "now". Defaults to "now".

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return (1–1000, default: 100). Prefer 20–50 for security investigations.

region.description: AWS region (e.g. us-east-1). Defaults to AWS_DEFAULT_REGION or us-east-1.

break_token_rule.description: Set to true to bypass token limits in critical situations (default: false).

tools.name: get_log_events
tools.description: Retrieve raw log events from a specific CloudWatch log stream. Use list_log_streams first to find the stream name. Supports time filtering and pagination. Ideal for: detailed incident timeline reconstruction, specific Lambda invocation logs.

logStreamName.description: Log stream name within the log group.

startTime.description: Start time. ISO format or relative (e.g. "1 hour ago"). Optional.

endTime.description: End time. ISO format or "now". Optional.

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return (1–1000, default: 100).

nextForwardToken.description: Pagination token from a previous get_log_events response.

region.description: AWS region. Defaults to AWS_DEFAULT_REGION or us-east-1.

break_token_rule.description: Set to true to bypass token limits in critical situations (default: false).

tools.name: list_log_groups
tools.description: List CloudWatch log groups in the current region. Use this first to discover available log groups before running queries. Supports prefix filtering to narrow results.

prefix.description: Filter log groups by name prefix. Example: "/aws/lambda"

limit.description: Maximum number of log groups to return (1–50, default: 50).

region.description: AWS region. Defaults to AWS_DEFAULT_REGION or us-east-1.

tools.name: list_log_streams
tools.description: List log streams within a CloudWatch log group, sorted by last event time (newest first). Use this to find the specific stream name before calling get_log_events. Supports prefix filtering.

logGroupName.description: CloudWatch log group name to list streams from.

limit.description: Maximum number of streams to return (1–50, default: 20). Sorted by last event time.

region.description: AWS region. Defaults to AWS_DEFAULT_REGION or us-east-1.

tools.name: describe_alarms
tools.description: List and inspect CloudWatch alarms and their current state (OK / ALARM / INSUFFICIENT_DATA). Filter by alarm name, prefix, or state. Ideal for: rapid triage of active incidents, validating monitoring coverage, checking if anomaly thresholds were breached during an incident.

alarmNames.description: List of specific alarm names to retrieve. If omitted, returns all alarms.

alarmNamePrefix.description: Filter alarms by name prefix. Cannot be used with alarmNames.

stateValue.description: Filter by alarm state. Omit to return all states.

maxRecords.description: Maximum number of alarms to return (1–100, default: 50).

region.description: AWS region. Defaults to AWS_DEFAULT_REGION or us-east-1.

break_token_rule.description: Set to true to bypass token limits in critical situations (default: false).

tools.name: get_metric_statistics
tools.description: Retrieve time-series statistics for a CloudWatch metric. Supports AWS built-in metrics (EC2, Lambda, ELB, RDS, etc.) and custom metrics. Ideal for: correlating resource usage spikes with security events, verifying network traffic anomalies, investigating error rate changes during incidents.

dimensions.description: Dimension filters to scope the metric to a specific resource.

startTime.description: Start time. ISO format or relative (e.g. "1 hour ago"). Defaults to "1 hour ago".

endTime.description: End time. ISO format or "now". Defaults to "now".

period.description: Aggregation period in seconds (minimum 60). Common values: 60 (1 min), 300 (5 min), 3600 (1 hour). Defaults to 300.

region.description: AWS region. Defaults to AWS_DEFAULT_REGION or us-east-1.
